title: Detection of Sars-Cov2 Using qPCR
author: Joseph Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfaujiew

steps.title: Prepare cDNA synthesis reaction
steps.instruction: Add Superscript IV VILO Master Mix and RNA to each PCR strip tube, mix, and run the cDNA synthesis program in a thermocycler.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µL Superscript IV VILO Master Mix (Fisher, 11‑755‑250) to each PCR tube.
Add 16 µL RNA sample to each PCR tube.
Gently mix by inversion and briefly centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom of the tube.
Place tubes in a thermocycler with constant lid temperature of 105 °C and run: 10 min at 25 °C, 60 min at 42 °C, 5 min at 85 °C, then hold at 4 °C (≈30 min total).

steps.title: Prepare qPCR master mix
steps.instruction: Combine master mix components for each reaction, selecting the appropriate probe (human RNaseP, SARS‑CoV‑2 N1, or N2).

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL 2× TaqMan GEX Master Mix (Fisher, 4369016).
Add 1 µL 20× Gene Expression Assay Probe (human RNaseP, SARS‑CoV‑2 N1, or N2).

steps.title: Dispense master mix into plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 14 µL of the prepared master mix into each well of a white semi‑skirted PCR plate (USA Scientific, 1402‑9790).

steps.title: Add cDNA to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 6 µL of the cDNA product from the synthesis reaction into the corresponding wells containing the master mix.

steps.title: Seal plate and run qPCR
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with optical sealing film (USA Scientific, 2978‑2700) and run the real‑time PCR program.

substeps.instruction: Seal plate with optical plate sealing film.
Place plate in a real‑time thermocycler and run: 2 min at 50 °C, 10 min at 95 °C, then 40 cycles of 15 s at 95 °C followed by 1 min at 60 °C.

steps.title: Interpret CT values
steps.instruction: According to CDC guidelines, only cycle‑threshold (CT) values below 35 are considered valid for the test.
